model.engine: ESS acceleration v2 (integration/ess-converged 9f4a292); launch presets not promoted (PR #18 QA-FAIL)

cg.basis: Typical sedan / hatchback. No ESS measurement. —  Indicative range 19–23.

frontTrack.basis: Wheelbase × 0.585 (16 modern ESS cars). —  Indicative range 58.9–66.4.

rearTrack.basis: Wheelbase × 0.585 (16 modern ESS cars). —  Indicative range 58.9–66.4.

grip.basis: 2000s ultra-high-performance summer tire (tire-type default; see acceleration validation).

cda.basis: Typical modern coupe/sedan Cd 0.30–0.36 × 22–24 ft². —  Indicative range 6.5–8.5.

frontSpring.basis: Spring giving a typical 1.3 Hz front ride frequency (car).

rearSpring.basis: Spring giving a typical 1.45 Hz rear ride frequency (car).

frontMotion.basis: MacPherson strut (incl. modified strut, coil on lower arm). Typical ranges for the architecture; motion ratio = spring travel ÷ wheel travel. Unsprung = per corner incl. wheel, tire, brake, half the links (live axle: half the axle). —  Indicative range 0.85–1.

rearMotion.basis: Independent multilink / integral link. Typical ranges for the architecture; motion ratio = spring travel ÷ wheel travel. Unsprung = per corner incl. wheel, tire, brake, half the links (live axle: half the axle). —  Indicative range 0.6–0.9.

frontUnsprung.basis: MacPherson strut (incl. modified strut, coil on lower arm). Typical ranges for the architecture; motion ratio = spring travel ÷ wheel travel. Unsprung = per corner incl. wheel, tire, brake, half the links (live axle: half the axle). —  Indicative range 70–100.

rearUnsprung.basis: Independent multilink / integral link. Typical ranges for the architecture; motion ratio = spring travel ÷ wheel travel. Unsprung = per corner incl. wheel, tire, brake, half the links (live axle: half the axle). —  Indicative range 75–105.

tireRate.basis: Typical tire vertical rate for the vehicle type. —  Indicative range 1000–2400.

weight.basis: 2024 Elantra N manual instrumented test — Publication's reported test-car curb/scale weight. Running weight, fuel load and driver mass were not specified. This is not the OEM curb figure.

front.basis: 2024 Elantra N manual instrumented test — MotorTrend 3236-lb test car front split. Fuel and driver mass not given.

wheelbase.basis: 2024 Elantra N manual instrumented test — Specification as reported by the test source; separate from instrumented results.

hp.basis: 2024 Elantra N manual instrumented test — Specification as reported by the test source; separate from instrumented results.

hpRpm.basis: 2024 Elantra N manual instrumented test — Specification as reported by the test source; separate from instrumented results.

torque.basis: 2024 Elantra N manual instrumented test — Specification as reported by the test source; separate from instrumented results.

torqueRpm.basis: 2024 Elantra N manual instrumented test — Specification as reported by the test source; separate from instrumented results.

redline.basis: Peak-power rpm × 1.067 (Supercar X archive median, 64 cars; range ×1.00–1.16). —  Indicative range 5500–6400.

diameter.basis: No tire size on record: typical diameter for the vehicle type. —  Indicative range 24–31.

test60.basis: 2024 Elantra N manual instrumented test — MotorTrend exact manual test. Lateral acceleration is average. Pad size and vehicle load not established.

testEt.basis: 2024 Elantra N manual instrumented test — MotorTrend exact manual test. Lateral acceleration is average. Pad size and vehicle load not established.

testTrap.basis: 2024 Elantra N manual instrumented test — MotorTrend exact manual test. Lateral acceleration is average. Pad size and vehicle load not established.

archFront.basis: Well-established factory architecture for this platform; record text missing. Verify against a factory manual.

archRear.basis: Well-established factory architecture for this platform; record text missing. Verify against a factory manual.

load-transfer.estimated: CG height (in), Front track (in), Rear track (in)

spring-rate.estimated: Front spring (lb/in), Rear spring (lb/in), Front motion ratio, Rear motion ratio, Front unsprung (lb/corner), Rear unsprung (lb/corner), Tire vertical rate (lb/in)

quarter.estimated: CG height (in), Upshift RPM (model shift point, not the rev limit), Rear tire diameter (in), Launch grip coefficient, Drag area (ft²)

oval.estimated: CG height (in), Upshift RPM (model shift point, not the rev limit), Rear tire diameter (in), Launch grip coefficient, Drag area (ft²)
